name: Get Brazil Visa
description: A specialist desk for foreigners applying for Brazilian residency / digital-nomad / retirement / family / investor visas. It helps navigate government portals; every application is personally reviewed by a licensed Brazilian immigration lawyer; 95%+ approval rate claimed (company-stated). Pricing: $599 flat for nomad / retirement / family; investor cases quoted. Founded Dec 2025, BR. React + Cloudflare + Supabase + Stripe. Channels: SEO, content marketing. ~127k Google Search impressions in L30 (TrustMRR / GSC).

mentions.evidence: MRR $0, ~$3,067 L30 (+7.6%), ~$10,042 last 3 months, ~$16,372 all-time, ~95% L30 profit margin. Revenue synced Oct 9, 2026 ~06:36 Warsaw (04:36 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: The PL/EU version: "Karta Pobytu / Blue Card / B2B contractor setup in Poland" as a fixed-price package with document checklists, appointment booking, and a bilingual lawyer review. Or the reverse: help Poles get digital-nomad visas in Spain / Portugal / Brazil with the same $499–$799 flat structure.

whyItPrints: Government portals are hostile; people pay once to have a human + checklist get them through. 95% margin, no seats, SEO-led. Same Conductor pattern as Fast Corp (BG company formation) and Easy Moving Permits (city curb permits).
